title: Kentucky Police Detective Allegedly Relied on False AI Facial Recognition Match, Leading to Nebraska Man's Arrest and Detention
summary: A Nebraska man alleges that a Florence, Kentucky, police detective relied solely on an AI facial-recognition match to identify him as a check-fraud suspect. He was arrested in Florida and jailed for more than two weeks before being released. Prosecutors later dismissed the charges after he proved he was working in Nebraska during the alleged offense. A federal judge allowed his civil-rights lawsuit to proceed.
